method: budget-limited behavioural distinguishability M(:8011) vs hpT(:8012); pure-python TF-IDF + logistic-regression discriminator, 5-fold CV
scope: LOWER BOUND on extraction difficulty (a full distillation surrogate is not trained here); low CV accuracy at low Q => a behavioural clone needs more queries => divert is not a cheaper extraction target
note: production M and the trained honeypot hpT are distinguishable with >=99% accuracy from only 15 queries, i.e. diverting does not hide the honeypot from a budget-limited behavioural probe and any extraction surrogate can be validated cheaply; reported as a LOWER BOUND on extraction cost (no distillation surrogate is trained).
